candidate_relations.reason: The CD138-positive, CD56-positive, CD20/PAX5-negative plasmablastic phenotype with MYC/IGH-associated gains and localized stage 1 disease supports plasmablastic lymphoma with high-risk features, not extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma, nasal type.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Incompatible lymphoma subtype despite shared nasal extranodal site and EBV positivity.
